rationale: The HB-200 base station auto-updated to firmware 4.5, which now supports only protocol v3. The office camera (CAM-I2, fw 1.2) still speaks protocol v2, so check_firmware_compat reports compatible=false with no OTA path (ota_available_to=null), and the base station logs E-305. Only this single device is offline while the other five remain online, confirming a device-level protocol mismatch rather than a system fault. Per escalation policy, a protocol mismatch with no OTA path must be escalated to FAE (L2), matching historical case H-03.

results.text: After HB-200 auto-updated to 4.5, a CAM-I2 running 1.2 disconnected with E-305. OTA not offered for this hardware revision. Escalated; FAE confirmed protocol v2 dropped and arranged a compatibility firmware. Escalated correctly.

Escalate when any of the following holds: (1) two or more peripherals fail at the same time while the base station is online; (2) a firmware or protocol mismatch remains after an OTA attempt or OTA is not possible; (3) the standard frontline fix was executed and the problem persists; (4) the app's device list and the base station binding table disagree; (5) a device fails even next to the base station after a factory reset.
